# Orlando Magic Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-10-13, 30:12. https://youtu.be/zhXtLr_xYVg

## Summary

Josh Lloyd previews the Orlando Magic for the 2026-27 fantasy season. The big unknown is what new coach Sean Sweeney changes in pace, offense, usage and the rotation. His projected starters are Jalen Suggs, Desmond Bane, Franz Wagner, Paolo Banchero and Wendell Carter Jr. Banchero is his best target: a clear value in Yahoo points leagues and fine at picks 50 to 65 in category leagues. Desmond Bane is his biggest fade, because his ADP in the 40s assumes long injuries to teammates. He sees Wendell Carter Jr. and Tristan da Silva as not draftable in 12-team leagues, Nikola Vucevic as a late-round swing and Anthony Black as a stash. Orlando's schedule is unremarkable.
